description: This file is a Bash shell script containing tests for git archive functionality, focusing on attributes, pathspecs, worktrees, and export-subst features.

methods.name: test_expect_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists, expecting success or failure based on the second argument.

methods.name: test_expect_missing
methods.description: Checks if a file does not exist, expecting success or failure based on the second argument.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a set of commands expecting success.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts lines in a file and compares against expected count.
